text_en: Get back, soldier!_500_ It's too dangerous. I will not let anyone else die today.
You won't change your mind then?_500_ Well..._100_ As you wish, it would be an honour to die fighting alongside you.

We didn't expect a clearing like this to be so treacherous._100_ That beast came bursting out, blocking our way and I couldn't do anything for them._500_
They're..._300_ soldiers...
They're not trained to fight these monsters.
Soldier,_300_ I don't know these lands,_300_ but I'm certain that you've just made history in them.
I often think my job is to give you hope but, in reality, you are the ones who give it to me._500_ Thank you for the reminder.
I don't know about you, but I'll never accept this fate. I swear that we will reach the very limits of this world if that's what it takes to get out of this place._500_ I see it clearly now.
It seems we are nearing the citadel._100_ We should rest there. Then I will make sure they are given a proper burial.
I will see you later._500_ I don't want to leave their bodies out in the open for too long, at the mercy of these forest beasts.
